mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in one month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a monetary easing cycle.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.
